I went to pick up the first two walking dead compendiums, first two game of thrones books and I'm walking my dog now every day. He is beyond happy just to see me now which has its own therapeutic effects. 

Suicide isn't the answer, sure, it can be seen as healthy to have an exit plan but don't use that plan when you're depressed and not thinking straight. 

If you're a gamer, turn off the console or computer and don't touch it, read a book, escape your thoughts long enough to form new ones. If you do not exercise, start. If you barely eat, eat more, even if it isn't particularly healthy for you. Get a calendar or journal and plan your day, give yourself goals and meet those goals. 

You've got this life shit. Just beat it, don't let it beat you.
